pages.text: With $(thing)JEI$() installed, each of the mod's items has an $(l)information$() page saying what it does.$(br2)There's also a $(l)Locomotive Fuel$() page for each locomotive (what it runs on, and how long it lasts as the server has it set) and a $(l)Track-Laying Wagon$() page (what it lays and fills dips with): look up an engine's uses, or a fuel's.
